notes.title: New Language Update, Supporters Pack DLC and Bundle ✨
notes.notes:
Hello cabin friends,

We hope you are all well!

We’re back with more exciting news to share with you!

Firstly, we have launched a new DLC called the ‘Supporters Pack’! This is for all of you who have loved playing The Cabin Factory and want to support us (the devs) in continuing to work on this and maybe even a new project! This pack includes exclusive bonus features like a unique Greta badge, your name in the game credits and a special mug featuring Hans’ frog friend 🐸 These are just a few of the exclusives waiting for you, just head over to the DLC to have a look for yourselves! You can also grab the Supporters Edition bundle which includes the DLC and the main game.

Secondly, we’ve been working on a big update for the main game! We now have new voices throughout the game in the following languages: French, Brazilian Portuguese and German 🌍 We hope this means more of you can enjoy our very normal game :) 

Finally, we are super excited to be joining the “Office Anomalies” bundle with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2259310/ORDER_13/]Order 13[/url] which has launched today from Cybernetic Walrus!! We’re very happy to be joining forces on this bundle, be sure to go check it out! 🔥

As always, we hope you will have lots of fun with these additions and we look forward to seeing more TCF content!

- ICS 🐈

notes.title: Our biggest discount EVER!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re very excited to be a part of the 'Hits You Missed’ sale by Fellow Traveller! It’s very humbling to see our little horror game in this line-up of fantastic indie gems from 2024 - be sure to check the other titles out as well! 

It’s also been exactly two months since we launched The Cabin Factory, so to celebrate, we decided to do our biggest sale ever with a 20% off discount 🎉
We hope those of you playing the game for the first time will have a wild and spooky time discovering all the secrets within each cabin 🏚️ 

That’s all for now, and we’ll be back to check in soon with more updates!

ICS 🐈

notes.title: We’re Steam Deck Verified!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It’s been just over a month since we launched and it has been such an incredible few weeks thanks to all of YOU! Here are some highlights from the last month:

🩸Over 140,000 of you have bought our spooky game!!
🩸Some huge streamers (and some less huge but not less amazing) have played TCF to millions of viewers 🤯 
🩸We’ve LOVED watching countless videos of you playing and reacting to the game- so much fun (and very funny…sorry!)
🩸And now, The Cabin Factory is verified on Steam Deck! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299976/80217dbe0645083d64259105e703586c26ff7136.jpg[/img]

This means you can inspect haunted cabins on the go! On the bus surrounded by strangers? Sitting in a park? Long-haul flight? At work? All perfect times to play our very cursed game!

We hope you will have lots of fun with this and we look forward to seeing more TCF content.

That’s all for now, speak soon!
- ICS 🐈

notes.title: The Cabin Factory is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello again,

We’re so excited to be writing to you today because The Cabin Factory is OUT NOW! 🎉 

[previewyoutube=Yqnk-LxxKFg;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you enjoy this spooky short which is in no way a reflection of our current mental state 😇 

We’ve been so thrilled by the reception that our little game has received since its announcement just over a month ago, and we hope that you’ll enjoy playing it as much as we’ve loved making it! 

Before you start this very safe and absolutely not cursed job of exploring cabins, here’s a few things to bear in mind:
If anything is moving that shouldn’t be, get out immediately!
Pay very close attention to each cabin so you don’t miss anything. Yes, even under the stairs.
Be 100% sure when you make your choice: Safe 🟢 or Haunted 🔴. Not to scare you, but you’ll be heavily penalised if you get it wrong.


That’s all from us for now! Please share your experience playing, we would love to see your reactions! Find us on X , Tiktok and Bluesky for all the spooky cabin content 🏚️👻

Goodbye, and good luck!
ICS 🐈

notes.title: Welcome to The Cabin Factory 👻
notes.notes:
Hello everyone 👋

We are International Cat Studios, the tiny team behind The Cabin Factory: a short horror anomaly-hunting experience🏚️. We’re so excited today, as we’re not only revealing our brand new game, but also announcing that this spooky tale will be yours to brave on [b]Friday the 13th of December, 2024[/b] (the second spookiest day of the year)! 

[previewyoutube=zra3izX0xXQ;full][/previewyoutube]


Seeing as we’ve not met before, it’s only right that we tell you a little bit about ourselves:

[list]
[*] We are based between Spain and Japan! 🌍
[*] We are partners in ICS and in life 👫
[*] We are the proud parents of two cats (hence the name) 🐱
[*] We have teamed up with the gang at Future Friends Games (Exo One, Europa, SUMMERHOUSE) to help with all things publishing 🎮
[*] We seek to create completely safe and totally-not-haunted experiences… 🏚️
[/list]

For all things haunted-cabin-related, be sure to add us to your wishlist, and follow us on X here: https://x.com/ICS_indie 🙏

That’s all for now,

ICS 🐈
